name: ghosthand
title: Ghosthand
description: Control connected iPhones using an installed Ghosthand daemon and signed-in Ghosthand account.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: run-task
commands.title: Run iPhone Task
commands.description: Give a connected iPhone an instruction using Ghosthand's hosted AI agent

commands.name: list-iphones
commands.title: List iPhones
commands.description: View connected iPhones, setup requirements, and active leases

commands.name: view-screen
commands.title: View iPhone Screen
commands.description: Preview, copy, or save an iPhone screenshot without taking control

commands.name: read-screen
commands.title: Read Screen Text
commands.description: Read and copy visible iPhone text using local OCR

commands.name: quick-actions
commands.title: iPhone Quick Actions
commands.description: Go home, scroll, lock, mute, type text, or tap a visible label

commands.name: open-setup
commands.title: Open Setup Instructions
commands.description: Open Ghosthand installation and iPhone setup instructions

tools.name: list-iphones
tools.title: List iPhones
tools.description: List local iPhones, exact phone IDs, readiness, and active lease holders. Use this before selecting a device.

tools.name: run-iphone-task
tools.title: Run iPhone Task
tools.description: Run a user-confirmed natural-language instruction through Ghosthand's hosted agent. Use for multi-step tasks in iPhone apps.

tools.name: read-screen-text
tools.title: Read iPhone Screen Text
tools.description: Read visible text using local OCR and share it with the AI conversation after confirmation.

tools.name: iphone-quick-action
tools.title: Perform iPhone Quick Action
tools.description: Perform one confirmed Home, scroll, lock, mute, type, OCR tap, or separate Enter action. Never automatically retries.

preferences.name: taskResponseMode
preferences.title: Task Progress
preferences.description: Stream progress, or request a single JSON response if streaming is unavailable. Changing this never retries a task.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
